topics.question: Derivation of Ikeda sum rule S_- - S_+ = 3(N-Z) from closure and [sigma, tau] commutators
topics.pedagogical_analogy: Bookkeeping of nucleon spin-isospin availability. Pauli blocking suppresses beta+ in neutron-rich nuclei while beta- exhausts full phase space.
topics.operator_conventions: tau_- |n> = |p>, tau_+ |p> = |n>, t3|n> = +1/2, t3|p> = -1/2 in standard nuclear convention. S_mp are dimensionless operator sums without gA^2. Physical rate sum involves (gA/gV)^2 * 3(N-Z).
topics.key_finding: Model-independent algebraic identity verified by closure and Clebsch-Gordan orthogonality. Retains validity across pnQTDA and pnQRPA as long as spin-orbit partner orbits are complete.
topics.counter_evidence: Apparent missing GT strength in beta decay reflects Q-window cutoff and strength migration rather than sum rule violation.
topics.methodological_boundary: Exact for full nucleonic space; does not constrain spectral shape or non-nucleonic isobar degrees of freedom.

topics.question: Difference between total sum rule and finite Q-window / single-branch half-life
topics.pedagogical_analogy: Total reservoir capacity vs narrow faucet opening. A large reservoir has little discharge if the valve is positioned above water level.
topics.algebraic_expression: lambda_if = ln(2)/t_if proportional to f(Z, W0) * B_if; W0 = 1 + (Q_beta - Ex)/(m_e c^2)
topics.physical_mechanism: Repulsive particle-hole interaction in spin-isospin channel pushes coherent Gamow-Teller Giant Resonance to 10-20 MeV, outside the narrow Q-value window (< 4 MeV) of beta decay.
topics.experimental_probes: Charge-exchange reactions (p,n), (3He,t), (d,2He) at 100-400 MeV/u and forward angles theta ~ 0 deg.
topics.key_finding: Single-branch beta decay only probes the fragmented tail (< 1% of total strength). Full sum rule requires (p,n) charge-exchange reactions where (d_sigma/d_Omega)_0deg proportional to B(GT).
topics.locator: Suhonen 2007 pp. 225-235; Zhi 2013 Table III; Gaarde 1983
topics.counter_evidence: 208Pb is stable against beta decay (rate = 0), yet exhibits a massive GTGR at 19.2 MeV with strength approaching 3(N-Z) under (p,n) bombardment.
topics.methodological_boundary: Beta-decay lifetimes are sensitive only to states within the Q-value window, not to high-lying collective resonances.

topics.question: Explanatory boundaries of effective operators, finite model space, two-body currents, and strength migration
topics.pedagogical_analogy: Accounting shortfall due to truncated ledger lines rather than missing currency. Strength is shifted to higher ledger lines.
topics.physical_mechanism: Phenomenological quenching is a composite surrogate for omitted 2p-2h tensor configurations (50-100 MeV), Delta-hole states (300 MeV), and chiral two-body currents (MEC).
topics.key_finding: Ikeda sum rule preserves total operator trace; strength is migrated to high excitation energies rather than destroyed. Effective coupling gA_eff is model-space and momentum dependent, precluding a universal constant.
topics.locator: Engel & Menendez 2017 pp. 17-19; Gysbers et al. 2019 Nat. Phys. 15, 428
topics.counter_evidence: Ab initio calculations with two-body currents in extended spaces reproduce experimental beta decay rates without empirical gA quenching.
topics.methodological_boundary: Model-space truncation factor cannot be transferred between shell model (0h-bar-omega) and ab initio frameworks.

topics.question: First-forbidden multi-rank shape factor C(W) and why it cannot be scaled by a uniform gA^2
topics.pedagogical_analogy: Multi-instrument orchestra playing in anti-phase. Scaling the brass section does not scale the Woodwinds or preserve harmonic cancellation.
topics.algebraic_expression: C(W) = k + ka*W + kb/W + kc*W^2; kb = (2/3)*mu1*gamma1 * { -[zeta0*w]^(0) + [zeta1*(x+u)]^(1) }
topics.key_finding: FF decay couples Rank 0, 1, and 2 operators. Vector current is protected by CVC (xi'_y = E_gamma * x, gV = 1), axial charge xi'_v is enhanced (q = 1.266 > 1) by MEC, while spatial axial operators are quenched (0.38-0.66). Uniform gA^2 scaling distorts cross-term interference and spectral shape.
topics.isolated_discrepancies: 205Hg -> 205Tl theoretical print mismatches in Zhi 2013 Table I (18.9 fm yields 6.41 but printed as 7.26; 10.3 fm yields 6.94 but printed as 6.32) isolated without refitting.
topics.locator: Zhi 2013 pp. 2-5 Eqs. 1-16, Table I; Warburton 1991; T04 audit
topics.counter_evidence: Only unique first-forbidden (Rank 2) admits single-operator scaling; non-unique channels fail catastrophically under scalar gA^2 multiplication.
topics.methodological_boundary: Non-unique FF spectral shapes depend critically on relative phases and interference between vector and axial matrix elements.

topics.question: 0vbb vs single beta: closure approximation, high momentum transfer, and non-extrapolability of GT quench
topics.pedagogical_analogy: Internal sub-femtometer photon-like exchange between adjacent nucleons vs macroscopic emission of a free real particle.
topics.algebraic_expression: q ~ hbar / r_12 ~ 100-200 MeV/c >> |En - E_bar| ~ 10 MeV; H(r) = (2 R / pi r) int dq [j0(qr) q / (q + E_bar - E0)]
topics.key_finding: Virtual neutrino exchange occurs at short distances, validating closure approximation and generating neutrino potential H(r). Virtual intermediate states span all multipoles J^pi up to 5-6, and chiral two-body currents soften quenching to only ~20-30%, invalidating naive (gA_eff/gA)^4 suppression.
topics.counter_evidence: 2vbb operates at q ~ 0 and is dominated by 1+ intermediate states, whereas 0vbb probes dense nuclear matter where short-range correlations dominate.
topics.methodological_boundary: Closure approximation breaks down in 2vbb but remains robust within 10% in 0vbb due to large energy denominator.

topics.question: Vaquero pairing coordinate delta as particle-number fluctuation, not BCS gap, and wave function restructuring
topics.pedagogical_analogy: Constraining quantum dispersion in particle number to sweep over superfluid Hilbert space rather than tuning an empirical gap parameter.
topics.algebraic_expression: delta = <phi | (Delta A_hat)^2 | phi>^(1/2) in PN-VAP constraint; M^0v = sum_{beta, delta} g_i * g_f * Kernel
topics.key_finding: delta measures particle-number standard deviation, avoiding BCS pairing gap collapse. NME is an off-diagonal transition matrix element connecting two distinct nuclei (not a directly measurable single-nucleus observable). Dynamic pairing fluctuations allow collective wave functions to sample broader superfluid configurations, increasing open-shell NMEs by 10%-40%.
topics.locator: Vaquero et al. 2013 PRL 111, 142501 pp. 2-4, Eqs. 2-5, Figs. 1-2, Table I
topics.counter_evidence: Doubly magic 48Ca decreases by -6% because its stiff ground state is constrained to weak pairing, proving nuclear structure selectivity.
topics.methodological_boundary: NME is not an experimentally measurable single-nucleus observable; pairing fluctuations modify wave function overlaps.

missing_phase1_foundation.item: Chiral EFT leading-order short-range two-nucleon contact counterterm g_nu^NN
missing_phase1_foundation.rationale: High-momentum transfer 0vbb exchange is UV-divergent at short distances without a contact operator C(r) to preserve renormalization group invariance. This counterterm cannot be constrained by low-energy single beta decay and remains the primary open theoretical operator foundation in Phase 1.
missing_phase1_foundation.impact_on_nme: Alters overall 0vbb nuclear matrix elements by 30% to 50% depending on regularisation scheme and cut-off scale.
